L316/L337 pass CH (not CHH) into outputs named CHHxL/CHHyL; CHH=CH*H computed at L307 is never used afterwards -- the flux formulas L322/L343 multiply CHHxL by HxL, so CHHxL actually holds reconstructed CH.

audit_member_text: The positive-V F4 diffusion branch uses H(I,J+1)+H(I,J) while its concentration difference and face velocity are on the south face J-1; the negative branch uses H(I,J-1)+H(I,J). This sign-dependent geometry mismatch changes diffusion solely with flow direction.
dispositions.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-28 by Codex deep re-audit: The positive-flow south-face diffusion uses the north-cell depth pair, while the negative branch uses the south-face pair. F4 feeds the concentration update and no guard or zero factor removes this sign-dependent geometry error.

audit_member_text: For px==1, the x wall block's IF(npx==0) ... ELSEIF(npx==px-1) executes only the west condition and skips the east condition. The y block has an explicit py==1 case setting both sides, confirming the x single-partition omission.
dispositions.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-28 by Codex deep re-audit: With px=1, npx is both 0 and px-1, so ELSEIF makes the east-wall F1 assignment unreachable. The analogous py=1 branch explicitly handles both ends, and no later x-boundary assignment neutralizes the omission.

audit_member_text: Both deposition implementations evaluate (1-n_porosity)/CH before multiplication by CH, with no CH>0 guard. Active wet cells can have CH=0 initially or after MAX clamping in sediment_solver, so division by zero precedes any algebraic cancellation.
dispositions.rationale: unmatched audit finding (mat=HIGH) | span-reviewed 2026-08-27 REFUTED as material delta: MIN(2.0,(1-n)/CH) caps Inf before *CH (L152/L249), benign result under IEEE; risk only under -ffpe-trap build. not promoted.

audit_member_text: The direct upwind path updates CH without nonnegative or upper-concentration clipping, while sediment_solver clamps both bounds. Selecting Sed_Scheme therefore changes not only discretization but admissible concentration handling.

sediment_flux forms HxL/HxR (Mloc1 by Nloc) and HyL/HyR (Mloc by Nloc1) by adding whole Zb, whose cell-centered shape is Mloc by Nloc. No face reconstruction or slice is applied to Zb, producing shape/interface inconsistency or wrong bed placement at faces.
dispositions.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-28 by Codex deep re-audit: Cell-centered Zb(Mloc,Nloc) is added as a whole array to x- and y-face arrays whose respective extents are Mloc1 and Nloc1. The intrinsic assignments require conforming shapes; there is no reconstruction, slice, or guard to make them conform.

audit_member_text: Pickup formulas divide by Tau_cr and c_b and logarithmic shear denominators without guarding zero or singular values. D50, Shields_cr, Sdensity and water depth input domains are not validated here.

The avalanche pass updates I-1/J-1 neighbors in-place and jumps back to label 96 after each correction, restarting the entire scan until a hard 1000-restart cap. Results depend on alternating traversal order and may exit with slopes still above tan_phi without reporting nonconvergence.

Avalanche reads and writes ghost-adjacent I-1/J-1 cells but update_bed performs no halo exchange inside or after the iterative relaxation. Cross-partition bed slopes can therefore use stale halos and diverge between decompositions.

Morph_step is used as both equality trigger and divisor without a positivity check. If it is zero, averaging divides by zero; if Counter_s is not initialized/reset consistently, the NE test can miss the sole equality trigger.
